idea-plugin.name: Not My TODO
idea-plugin.description:
A TODO list attached to your code, with items you can hand to an AI agent to fix.

  • Capture: select code, press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Z (or right-click, Add TODO), and type. !p1..!p3 sets the priority and #word adds a tag. With nothing selected it saves a plain note.
  • List: the Not My TODO tool window at the bottom. Search with words, an id like T-12, #tag and !p1. Double-click an item to jump to its code.
  • Anchors: items follow their code as you edit, switch branches, or let an agent change files. If the code can no longer be found the item shows "Anchor lost", and you can re-attach it to a selection. An item can be attached to several places, and to a whole file as well as to lines.
  • Fix with Claude: sends an item, with its code and the lines around it, to Claude Code in a terminal tab or to the clipboard.
  • MCP tools: with the IDE's MCP server enabled, agents can use todo_list, todo_get, todo_create, todo_update, todo_comment, todo_batch and todo_decided to read items, add their own, comment on them, record what was decided, and mark them fixed.

Items are stored in .todos/items.json in the project root, so an agent without MCP can read the file directly.

Requires a JetBrains IDE version 2026.2 or newer.

Open source under the Apache 2.0 license. Source code and issue tracker: github.com/konove/not-my-todo.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.0

  • Items can be attached to several places, and to a whole file as well as to lines.
  • Items have a comment log, so an agent can add a finding without rewriting the details.
  • Items can be blocked by another item, marked as a duplicate, or made part of a parent item. A blocked item shows a padlock.
  • Items can carry an effort estimate of s, m or l; search for it with !s, !m and !l.
  • Items record where they came from, the commit that fixed them and a note on what was done.
  • An agent that needs a decision asks in a comment, and a balloon shows the question. The item keeps what was asked and what was answered.
  • New MCP tools: todo_comment, todo_batch and todo_decided. todo_list filters by several tags, excluded tags, several statuses, a directory, text, effort, lost anchors, blocked items and parent, and has a compact mode. Its tag parameter is now tags.
  • The detail pane puts the code beside the text, and the list, the detail pane and the gutter popup show an item as the same chips. The filter bar wraps when the list is narrow.
  • .todos/items.json is now written as version 2, which keeps fields added by newer versions of the plugin. Files written by 0.1.0 are still read; 0.1.0 cannot read a file written by this version.

0.1.0

  • First release: capture TODO items from the editor, a tool window to search and manage them, anchors that follow the code, Fix with Claude, and MCP tools for agents.
